command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(java|javaw|node|dart|dartaotruntime|flutter|gradle|docker|com\.docker.*)\.exe$' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name); $l=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in @(3000,4317,5005,8080,8081,9006,5037,5433,4566) } | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess); @{atUtc=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o');processes=$p;listeners=$l;commandLinesCollected=$false} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"
